mobbin:98d1b7e8-cff5-47a9-84e7-278eb2650.summary: During an active live recording the host taps Mark Clip; a toast confirms a timestamped clip and the button badge increments the marker count.
steps: Live REC with Mark Clip on toolbar
Toast Clip created from marker + Mark Clip (3)
steal: One-tap Mark Clip on the live control bar (no form) while REC and upload % stay visible (step Live REC with Mark Clip).
Toast with absolute timestamp: 00:03:59 Clip created from marker, dismissible (step Toast Clip created).
Button label gains count Mark Clip (3) so overlapping markers stay countable (step Toast Clip created).
Per-participant upload health: 720p 97% uploaded beside REC in People panel (step Live REC with Mark Clip).
mobbin:98d1b7e8-cff5-47a9-84e7-278eb2650.fit: Extends SRV live/control capture: quick-tag markers that later land on the existing timeline marker row above chapters; count badge helps the known overlapping-marker risk.

mobbin:97d3f401-44c3-430b-ac7e-11e365f63.summary: Host opens Invite people (link/email + roles); a red banner says An error occurred, please try again later with no cause or recovery path.
steps: Invite people modal over studio (audio-only banner)
Generic red error toast over invite modal
steal: Invite roles with plain-language copy: Audience vs Guest vs Producer not recorded (step Role dropdown).
Audio only: Video won't be recorded… with Switch to video recording shortcut (step Invite people modal).
avoid: Generic An error occurred, please try again later with no failed action, cause, or retry — unusable for non-technical faculty mid-session.
mobbin:97d3f401-44c3-430b-ac7e-11e365f63.fit: Counter-example for control-room errors outside SRV: invite/check-in failures must name the action and next step, not a dismiss-only banner over the Invite modal.

mobbin:7a5685e7-9d0d-44c5-afe1-4cdc3eef5.summary: Host opens a Riverside studio, chooses Start recording vs Run test recording, waits through a 3-2-1 countdown, then watches live REC with Stop, Mark Clip, and upload %.
steps: Record menu — Start vs Run test recording
steal: Record split: Start recording vs Run test recording (stopwatch) on the same red control (step Record menu).
Large numeric countdown on the video with control label Starting… before REC (step Countdown overlay).
Stop shows elapsed time (00:27) and stays separate from Leave (step Live REC).
Header REC pill plus ↑ 93% Uploading… and per-host 720p / 93% uploaded in People (step Live REC).
avoid: Empty Invite people tile equal to the live feed on the main stage — competes with monitoring during start.
mobbin:7a5685e7-9d0d-44c5-afe1-4cdc3eef5.fit: Models control-room start/stop outside SRV (one-button Start, optional test pass, countdown, REC + upload health); Mark Clip seeds the same timeline markers SRV already shows under the video.
